report.title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow in TELNET NEW_ENV Option Handling
report.body:
A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the `libcurl` TELNET handler. When `libcurl` connects to a malicious TELNET server, the server can trigger an overflow by sending a `NEW_ENVIRON SEND` request. The length check uses strlen() but msnprintf() then adds two control bytes (CURL_NEW_ENV_VAR / CURL_NEW_ENV_VALUE), bypassing the 2048-byte bound in suboption() in lib/telnet.c, leading to DoS or RCE.

This affects libcurl. Please confirm and assign a CVE.
